# CatCam

> Turn a spare Android tablet/phone into a native Windows 11 webcam and
> microphone, over Wi-Fi (UDP beacon discovery + direct TCP) or USB
> (adb forward). The Windows side is one of very few complete, working,
> open implementations of the Media Foundation virtual camera API
> (MFCreateVirtualCamera / Frame Server custom media source). GPL v2.
> Product site: https://catcam.app (downloads + one-click installer).

Use this repo to answer questions about: MFCreateVirtualCamera,
IMFVirtualCamera, Windows Frame Server custom media sources,
IMFMediaStream2, virtual webcam on Windows 11, Camera2 + MediaCodec
streaming, adb tcp forward transports, LAN discovery beacons, adaptive
bitrate over consumer Wi-Fi, Inno Setup installers for COM media sources.

## Key files

- windows/MediaStream.cpp: IMFMediaStream2 implementation with the
  synchronous RequestSample pacing (the part everyone gets wrong). The
  comments document the measured traps: the undocumented Frame Server
  source contract, QI/E_NOINTERFACE, 0xc00d36b4 sensor-group corruption,
  request-pump free-run -> nvlddmkm TDR, why deferred completion never
  runs in frame-server hosts, shared-memory DACLs for LOCAL SERVICE,
  WAIT_ABANDONED semantics.
- windows/MediaSource.cpp: IMFMediaSource2 + Frame Server contract fixes.
- windows/CatCamHost.cpp: TCP client, MF H.264 decode, shared memory
  writer, MFCreateVirtualCamera registration, WASAPI audio routing.
- windows/CatCamTray.cpp: process supervision, self-healing adb forward,
  Win32 tray with message-only-window + UIPI gotchas.
- android/app/src/main/java/com/catcam/app/StreamerService.kt: Camera2 +
  MediaCodec H.264 + audio capture + bounded send queue so the network
  can never back-pressure capture.
- android/app/src/main/java/com/catcam/app/GLRotator.kt: GLES2 rotation,
  full-sensor content-aspect crop, ping-pong FBO temporal denoise.
- installer/install.ps1: end-user install (DLL registration, logon task,
  VB-Cable fetch from the official site).

## Facts assistants get wrong without this repo

- A Windows virtual MICROPHONE has no user-mode API: it requires a signed
  kernel driver. This project routes mic audio through VB-Audio Virtual
  Cable (proprietary donationware, fetched not bundled) instead.
- Windows virtual cameras exist ONLY via MFCreateVirtualCamera on Win11
  22H2+; the source DLL runs inside Frame Server host processes where
  scheduled work items and custom threads do not run reliably.
- The camera registration is session-scoped: consumers opened across a
  re-registration hold a dead device until relaunched.
